item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs agencies to provide staff resources and expertise when requested by the Director, an internal interagency coordination and resource-allocation measure without itself changing legal rights or dictating a later legal outcome.","evidence":"make its resources in staff, and knowledge and experience available to the Economic Stabilization Agency"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The segment mandates internal administrative assistance through temporary personnel assignments, information sharing, services, facilities, and field-office notification; these are executive-management measures rather than prescribed legal consequences.","evidence":"each agency shall provide such cooperation and assistance, consonant with law, as it can"}]}
